source.content: @isTest private class CoreRuntimeCB62MessagingEvidenceTest { @isTest static void rows() { Messaging.SingleEmailMessage message = new Messaging.SingleEmailMessage(); message.setSubject('Subject'); message.setToAddresses(new List<String>{'to@example.test'}); System.assertEquals('Subject', message.getSubject()); Messaging.EmailFileAttachment attachment = new Messaging.EmailFileAttachment(); attachment.setFileName('note.txt'); attachment.setContentType('text/plain'); attachment.setBody(Blob.valueOf('note body')); System.assertEquals('note.txt', attachment.getFileName()); Messaging.InboundEmail email = new Messaging.InboundEmail(); System.assertEquals(null, email.subject); Messaging.InboundEmail.BinaryAttachment binary = new Messaging.InboundEmail.BinaryAttachment(); binary.fileName = 'trail.bin'; System.assertEquals('trail.bin', binary.fileName); } }
